Launching today

See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent [...] See how simulated buyers react, right in your agent

Most teams ship, then hope it lands. Articos MCP lets you check first. Right inside Claude or ChatGPT, run your headlines, positioning, or pages past simulated buyers based on your actual customers, and see how they respond before it goes out. Validated against human research from Baymard and Nielsen Norman, it agrees 86% of the time.

results.content:
What are your plans for the product's future development?

Owais Khan

@maria\_anosova we just released a live calling feature that lets you talk to your synthetic audience in real time. A few more things are in the pipeline too, including an MCP server, video calling, and UI/UX improvements.  
  
Always open to feedback, feel free to try it out and share your thoughts.

Amirul

Nice work maintaining #3 through the day, that's not easy on PH.  
  
The synthetic users angle is what caught my eye. If you are really hitting 86% accuracy on message testing without human panels, that's a big deal for smaller teams.   
  
Good luck with the rest of the launch 🚀

Owais Khan

@1mirul Thanks a lot 🙏 [...] Shaheer Gadit

@owais\_khan22  @priya\_kushwaha1 Thx Priya appreciate the support!

Owais Khan

@priya\_kushwaha1 thanks for all the support! Stay tuned for more updates :)

Aleksandar Blazhev

Congrats on the launch and the great results @owais\_khan22 ! Amazing launch day for you.

Would you share more about the roadmap? The future features you're planning to introduce?

Shaheer Gadit

@owais\_khan22  @byalexai

Thx Aleksandar for your support! There are few major things top of the mind for us:

MCP

Video calling ( we recently launched audio calling btw)

Credits based pricing instead of rigid per study pricing

Capability to upload your own personas

Kate Ramakaieva

great done! congrats! it was a really highly competitive day 🙌
